name: sandbox
description: A self-hostable local stand-in for payment providers.

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,app -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w sandbox-api" "npm run dev -w sandbox-app"
scripts.build: npm run build -w sandbox-api && npm run build -w sandbox-app
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w sandbox-api && npm run typecheck -w sandbox-app
